CAT: Purrs, ignores you, and owns the internet
DOG: Loyal, waggy, and always ready for a walk
COW: Chews the cud and fills the milk jug
PIG: Pink, muddy, and mad for truffles

APE: The tailless cousin on our family tree
BEAR: Sleeps all winter, then raids the picnic
LION: Wears a mane and answers to king
WOLF: Howls at the moon and hunts in a pack
FROG: Green, hops, and was once a prince
CRAB: Walks sideways and argues with claws
SEAL: Barks, claps, and balances a ball
MOLE: Near-blind digger who wrecks the lawn
SWAN: The ugly duckling, all grown up
TOAD: The warty cousin of the pond hopper
MULE: Half horse, half donkey, all stubborn
TIGER: Burning bright, orange with black bars
HORSE: Four legs, a mane, and a Derby to win
SHEEP: Counted at bedtime, shorn in spring
MOUSE: Tiny, squeaky, and terrified of the cat
SNAKE: No legs, forked tongue, blamed since Eden

OTTER: Floats on its back and holds hands asleep
SHARK: Rows of teeth and a very famous fin
EAGLE: Sharp-eyed bird on the American seal

FALCON: The fastest diver in the sky
PARROT: Repeats everything and sits on a pirate
TURTLE: Carries its house and is in no hurry
WALRUS: Whiskers, blubber and two great tusks
ELEPHANT: Never forgets, and packs its own trunk
GIRAFFE: The tallest neck on the savannah

DOLPHIN: Clicks, leaps, and may be smarter than you
